fusions.name: Silver Scatter
fusions.desc: Flicks out 3 silver darts at once, spread apart, each of which deals 3 damage. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Shoal Breaks Apart
fusions.desc: Sends a tight knot of silver at the first enemy in its path, where it deals 28 damage and bursts apart, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that. You move 30% faster for 4 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Slip the Net
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 holding conditions from you, such as [Stunned], [Pinned] or [Slowed], and you move 30% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Darting Minnows
fusions.desc: A bonded shoal of minnows darts around you, striking an enemy within 4 tiles for 2 damage every 0.6 seconds.
